Hero.h1: Industrial Skylights, Polycarbonate Roofing & Roof Ventilation for Tanzania

about: For skylights Tanzania projects, Dura Plast supplies Rhino Tuff dome skylights, polycarbonate roofing sheets and roof ventilators for factories, warehouses and commercial buildings in Dar es Salaam and across Tanzania. We have designed and manufactured skylights and natural ventilation systems since 2010, with turn-key support from design to delivery. Share your roof type, size and location, and our team will suggest the right skylight, sheet or ventilator.

Dura Plast is a skylight and roof ventilation design and development company, established in **2010**. We offer tailor-made, turn-key solutions that cover design, manufacturing, delivery and installation.
Our Rhino Tuff range brings together skylights, polycarbonate and FRP roofing sheets and natural roof ventilation, so one supplier can handle daylight, roofing and airflow on the same project.
For Tanzanian buyers, we work from your roof drawing or site details: roof type, span, sheet profile and quantity. We then recommend a product and send a quote.

footprint.heading: Industrial skylights for Tanzania
paragraphs: A well-placed skylight cuts daytime lighting load and makes a warehouse or factory floor brighter and easier to work in. Skylights Tanzania buyers ask for most often are dome skylights for steel roofs, flat roof skylights and insulated skylights for sandwich panels.

items.label: Dome skylights for steel roofs:
items.text: for metal-sheet roofs on factories and warehouses.

items.label: Flat roof skylight domes:
items.text: for concrete and flat roofs on commercial and institutional buildings.

items.label: Insulated skylights for sandwich panels:
items.text: for roofs built from sandwich panels.

items.label: Tubular skylights:
items.text: daylight for rooms with little or no roof access.

outro: Tell us your roof type and we will match the skylight to it. Our turn-key service covers installation, so one supplier can handle supply and fitting on the same project.

footprint.heading: Roof ventilation for Tanzanian warehouses and factories
paragraphs: Hot air collects under metal roofs, especially over production lines and storage areas. Roof ventilators let it escape without using electricity for the airflow.

items.label: Wind turbine ventilators:
items.text: spin with the wind and draw hot air out of the warehouse or factory.

items.label: Hybrid ventilators:
items.text: for sites that want ventilation to continue in low wind.

items.label: Skylight and turbine ventilator combos:
items.text: daylight and roof ventilation from one roof opening.

outro: Send the building size and roof layout and we will suggest how many ventilators suit it.

footprint.heading: Polycarbonate roofing sheets for Tanzania
paragraphs: Polycarbonate roofing sheets, like mabati, cover roofs, but they let daylight through. They are used for translucent roofs, skylight panels, walkway covers and wall glazing. We supply flat and corrugated polycarbonate sheet, and FRP roof sheets for translucent panels on metal roofs.

items.label: Flat polycarbonate sheets:
items.text: for glazing, canopies and cut-to-size panels.

items.label: Corrugated polycarbonate sheets:
items.text: profiled to match common metal roofing so they sit in the same roof line.

outro: When you enquire, tell us the thickness, sheet size, quantity and colour you need, and we will confirm what we can supply. Pricing depends on those details, so we quote against your specification.

solutions.subheading: From a single warehouse to a multi-building plant, we scope the roof, supply the products and support installation. Industries we serve include manufacturing, warehousing and logistics, retail and commercial buildings, and institutions.

items.title: Capability
items.description: Since 2010, Dura Plast has designed and made skylights and roof ventilation systems, and supplies them with turn-key support.

faq.q: What types of skylights can I get for a factory or warehouse in Tanzania?
faq.a: Dome skylights for steel roofs, flat roof skylight domes, insulated skylights for sandwich panel roofs and tubular skylights. The right one depends on your roof type and size.
A dome skylight is a raised, domed polycarbonate panel fitted over an opening in the roof. It lets daylight into the building while sealing the opening against the weather.

faq.q: Can you help with skylight installation?
faq.a: Dura Plast offers turn-key solutions that cover design, manufacturing, delivery and installation. Send your roof details and location so we can confirm the scope for your project.

faq.q: How is a polycarbonate roofing sheet different from mabati?
faq.a: Mabati is the Swahili word for roofing sheets, usually metal. A polycarbonate roofing sheet covers a roof in the same way but lets daylight through, so it is often used for translucent panels in a metal roof.

faq.q: What types of polycarbonate roofing sheets are available?
faq.a: Flat sheets, corrugated sheets profiled to sit alongside metal roofing, and FRP roof sheets for translucent panels.

faq.q: What is a wind turbine ventilator?
faq.a: A wind turbine ventilator is a roof-mounted unit that spins with the wind and pulls hot air out of a warehouse or factory.
Wind turbine ventilators use wind to move air out of the building. Hybrid ventilators are an option where wind is low.
Price depends on thickness, sheet size, profile, colour and quantity, so we quote against your specification.

faq.q: How do I get a quote?
faq.a: Share your roof type, approximate size, city and the product you need through the Get a Quote page, or email sales@duraplastindia.com.
